description: Search approved Shipstry launches by keyword, category, or tag. Keyword matching covers product name and tagline. Returns compact records with votes, ship week, awards, and the canonical Shipstry URL.

category.description: Category slug. One of: developer-tools, design-tools, marketing-sales, finance, education, health-wellness, social, ecommerce, entertainment, ai-ml, travel, productivity, data-analytics, web3, security-privacy, hardware, media-news, other.

query.description: Keyword matched against product name and tagline.

sort.description: hot = all-time by votes, new = newest first, week = launched in the current ship week, month = launched this month.

tag.description: Tag slug, for example 'vpn' or 'beta'. See get_category_landscape for tags common in a category.

name: search_launches
title: Search launches
